evidence_tree.isolation_note: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/ (including scripts/golden_baseline.json and the scenario definitions), docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, the diff and git history were never opened. The scenario's own input tuple is therefore NOT visible to this oracle; the computation below is a ratio/rule identification, not an absolute re-simulation, and its residual assumption is stated explicitly.

sources_quoted.quote: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.

step_1_observed_ratio.note: Both leaf values are reported to one decimal, so the true underlying ratio lies in [101.65/94.15, 101.75/94.05] = [1.079660, 1.081871].

step_2_candidate_constants_tested_agains.check: 94.1 * 1.08 = 101.628; underlying old in [94.1204, 94.15) reproduces 101.7 exactly after rounding

step_2_candidate_constants_tested_agains.constant: 1.06 (one Black Cleaver Carve stack, if armor were 0)

step_3_black_cleaver_alternative_ruled_o.model: With Sec. 2.1, damage ratio for an armor-reduction change from s1 to s2 Carve stacks (6% each) on base armor A is (100 + (1-0.06*s1)*A) / (100 + (1-0.06*s2)*A).
solved_for_A_at_ratio_1.0808: 4 stacks -> Cesaro max 4.5 stacks: A < 0 (the required direction is unattainable; Cesaro mean C - C(C-1)/(2h) = 5 - 10/h never exceeds 5 and equals 4 at h = 10, so the documented Cesaro fix cannot produce a +8% jump)
3 stacks -> 5 stacks: A = 127 (numerically possible, but 5 stacks is the cap, not a mean, and no cached rule produces a jump from a 3-stack to a full-cap model)
0 stacks -> 5 stacks: A = 33 (would require Carve to have been entirely absent, contradicting the scenario name)
step_3_black_cleaver_alternative_ruled_o.conclusion: No Black Cleaver stacking-model change yields a clean 1.08 at any plausible armor; the Cleaver hypotheses need a bespoke armor value, whereas the Bloodsong hypothesis needs a constant that is literally printed in the cached wiki text.

step_4_rule_reconstruction.statement: The leaf moved by exactly the melee Expose Weakness amplifier. Old = un-amplified pair damage D; new = D * 1.08.
step_4_rule_reconstruction.derivation: Bloodsong's Spellblade, on an empowered basic attack against a champion, applies Expose Weakness for 4 s: the victim takes 8% (melee holder) increased damage FROM ALL SOURCES. In a coupled roster ledger, 'pair_damage' is damage dealt to that defender, so an active Expose Weakness debuff multiplies it: pair_damage = D_base * (1 + 0.08).
step_4_rule_reconstruction.numeric_check: D_base (unrounded) must lie in [94.1204, 94.15) to display 94.1 and, after x1.08, display 101.7. E.g. D_base = 94.14 -> 94.14 * 1.08 = 101.67 -> 101.7. Consistent.
step_4_rule_reconstruction.why_old_is_wrong: 94.1 = D_base * 1.00, i.e. no Expose Weakness amplifier at all. Under either branch of {{rd|8%|5%}} the un-amplified value is wrong once the debuff is live in that event, so 'old_value_correct' is excluded unless Expose Weakness should not be active at events[39] - and if it were not active, the new value would not have moved by exactly the printed 8%.

step_5_residual_assumption.assumption: The Bloodsong holder in this roster is MELEE, so the {{rd|8%|5%}} template resolves to 8%.
step_5_residual_assumption.why_it_is_the_supported_reading: The scenario pairs Bloodsong with Black Cleaver, whose Carve stacks require repeatedly dealing physical damage and which is a melee-bruiser/melee-support purchase; the cached rd calibration makes 8% the melee branch; and the engine's own new value lands on 8%, not 5%.
step_5_residual_assumption.falsifier: If the Bloodsong holder in this roster is a RANGED champion, the correct amplifier is 1.05 -> 98.8, and the verdict would flip to 'both_wrong'. This oracle could not read the scenario's champion list (it lives outside the permitted evidence tree: data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json contains no 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' entry, and the golden scenario definitions live under scripts/). Recommended cheap confirmation by a party allowed to read the scenario: check the attackType / melee-ranged flag of the Bloodsong holder in cleaver_bloodsong_roster.

computed_value_expression: D_base * (1 + 0.08), with D_base the un-amplified pair damage reported as the old leaf (94.1 rounded; ~94.12-94.15 unrounded)
verdict_rationale: The leaf's movement is exactly the Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness' melee amplifier (8% increased damage from all sources) quoted verbatim from the cached wiki text in data/items.json id 3877. That constant is the only sourced constant in the rounding-admissible ratio interval [1.07966, 1.08187]; 5%, 6%, 10% and every Black-Cleaver stacking-model change are excluded. The old value carried no amplifier at all.
